requirements.vsum_req_note: Servo must hold Vsum so |Vlin-z|<=1e-3. Exp 26 o2 servo Vsum ~0.67 uV. Uncorrected Vos ceiling ~22 uV (Exp 22). 214 uV is the representative raw offset.
requirements.loop_gain_note: Behavioral Architecture A uses A=1e5. Isolated miller no-servo A_eff~1.7e3 on o2. Servo is required for analog pass on the worst neuron.
requirements.output_load_note: Architecture A hidden ReLU is a B-source: it isolates h*lin from the OPA189 invert and layer-2 fabric. Output-neuron TIA load is Rf plus that neuron's summing fabric. Shared-fabric coupling is through the input taps / hidden voltages, not TIA output current into invert.

decision.title: PHYSICAL TIA PARTIALLY VALIDATED
why: 200 us Gear insertion analog-passes; DC insertion remains solver-branchy and is not promoted as a DC OP result
full Network F was not transistorized; remaining TIA copies stay behavioral
MOS offset/temperature still requires the documented CDS path; not a new architecture
decision.dominant_remaining_bottleneck: resistor technology / foundry PDK (TCR, mismatch PDF, layout parasitics, switch nonidealities). The teaching-card miller is not silicon. OPA189 remains a vendor macromodel.
decision.note: A is mixed-level: representative physical TIA copies inside the qualified OPA189 invert fabric. Not a fully transistorized Network F. Not silicon.
